rules.label: Possible robot dog · CyberDog-style BLE
rules.scope: Matches this CyberDog software version only; name, service UUID and manufacturer bytes all required.

rules.label: Possible robot dog · Unitree Go1-style Wi-Fi
rules.scope: Default Go1 access-point name only. Renamed networks, client mode and other Unitree models do not match.

rules.label: Possible robot dog · Petoi Bittle setup Wi-Fi
rules.scope: Optional ESP8266 controller setup access point; a module may be detached from a robot.

rules.label: Possible robot dog · Petoi Bittle-style BLE
rules.scope: Default BiBoard firmware name only; two hexadecimal suffix characters. Custom names and other boards may not match. No service is required because this firmware does not explicitly advertise one.

rules.scope: Default BiBoard firmware name only; two hexadecimal suffix characters. Custom names and other boards may not match. No service is required because this firmware does not explicitly advertise one.

rules.scope: Default BiBoard firmware name only; two hexadecimal suffix characters. Custom names and other boards may not match. No service is required because this firmware does not explicitly advertise one.

rules.label: Possible ground robot · RoboMaster S1-style Wi-Fi
rules.scope: Manufacturer-documented direct Wi-Fi naming pattern. Router mode, renamed access points and other models are not covered.
